column1: # Covers: brands originating in or headquartered in Australia: banks, insurers, super funds and fintech, telecom,

# dairy, soft drinks, coffee, beer, wine and spirits, restaurant chains, mining and energy, industrial and
# property companies, healthcare, tech, software, apps and game studios, children's TV and toys, airlines,
